name: hobbyhub
description: Experience Booking Platform built with MERN Stack

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.start: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (!fs.existsSync('./dist/index.html') && !fs.existsSync('./client/dist/index.html')) { console.log('Building client before launch...'); import('child_process').then(cp => cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'})); } });" && node server/index.js

author: Antigravity
